So you can have ascending & descending color rows that add visual interest to your board! When I find myself tempted to not do a habit I'm trying to build, I find myself not wanting to break the colors, which helps me do the habit! Hook, line, and sinker, this app is truly effective at helping build habits (or break bad ones). My only feedback was for the web version, to "freeze" the top row so that the dates stay put even if you have to scroll thru the habits. Joan was responsive to that feedback. Great work, great app!
